__instructions__: Replace every value below with your fund's real number. Delete the lines starting with __ before saving. Keep the structure exactly; SHINE reads field names. Currency is the entity currency, units are absolute dollars (or your currency), no thousands.

balance_sheet.__instructions__: Asset and liability line names are arbitrary. SHINE foots whatever you list against the stated total.

schedule_of_investments.__instructions__: One entry per investment. Levels are 1, 2 or 3. Type one of: equity, debt, derivative, fund (= NAV practical expedient).

statement_of_changes.__by_class_instructions__: Optional. Add a class entry per partner class with the same shape as the parent fields plus class_id.

cash_flows.__instructions__: Set present=false to elect out (ASC 946 only). When false the engine records the election as an out-of-scope skip.

financial_highlights.__instructions__: Ratios are decimal fractions, not percentages: 3.63 percent = 0.0363.

tie_out.__instructions__: Optional. Paste figures from your tie-out workbook here so SHINE can cross-check the statements against the workbook. Each key is a dotted path into this file. Mismatches surface as tie-out breaks.
